svg.text: index = min(level, max) / step + rowLength * kind
base: the base class of class slot 0 (paladin and ranger count as fighter)
level: levels[0], the first class slot only
kind: the row, 0 to 4 (poison and death 0, paralysis 2, spell damage 4)
success: a d20 roll of at least target
dwarf, gnome, halfling: a constitution bonus is subtracted (see text)
THE FOUR TABLES, KIND BY COLUMN (VALUES READ FROM THE IMAGE)
Example: a fighter of level 5 saves against spell damage (kind 4) with index 5 / 2 + 10 * 4 = 42, the value 16 (red): a d20 roll of 16 or more.
The values agree with the AD&D first edition saving throw matrices for the same classes [H: recalled, not from the files].
